reviews.title: Review on Nebula
reviews.text: It was fun overall. It makes you feel hopeful🥰
reviews.reply:
Hello there,

Thank you for your feedback. We’re glad to hear the app was fun for you and that it left you feeling hopeful — that’s exactly the kind of positive experience we aim to bring.

If you’d like to share more about what made it uplifting or suggest improvements, please reach out at support-appstore@asknebula.com.

With appreciation,
Nebula
